headlines: GALE WATCH IN EFFECT FROM THURSDAY MORNING THROUGH LATE THURSDAY NIGHT

periods.name: This afternoon
periods.text: East winds 10 to 15 knots increasing to 15 to 20 knots. Mostly sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: East winds 15 to 25 knots. Mostly cloudy. Waves 2 to 4 feet building to 3 to 5 feet. Waves occasionally around 6 feet.

periods.name: Thursday
periods.text: East winds 15 to 25 knots becoming northeast and increasing to 35 knot gales in the afternoon. Rain. Waves 3 to 6 feet building to 9 to 12 feet. Waves occasionally around 15 feet.

periods.name: Thursday night
periods.text: Northeast gales to 35 knots becoming north and diminishing to 30 knots overnight. Rain. Waves 8 to 12 feet subsiding to 5 to 8 feet. Waves occasionally around 15 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Friday through Sunday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 47 degrees, off Cleveland 53 degrees, and off Erie 51 degrees.
